info.title: Portable Commerce Mall — new host HTTP contracts
info.description: New endpoints only; existing 29 onboarding operations unchanged. Trusted session realm/tenant/store and named capabilities. No body actor, payer identity, paid flag or provider proof. CNY JSAPI protocol adapter is fail-closed until authoritative app-bound payer binding is installed; TWD online routes (NewebPay, LINE Pay, JKOPay) remain unavailable. Task8 adds offline bank-transfer purchase: merchant declarations, private evidence, operator confirmation/void, assisted STORE orders and offline refund payouts. TWD policy twd-whole-v1 uses cash/allocation quantum 100.

categories.description: Enabled categories used by the visible products plus all ancestors, ordered by (level, sortOrder, code).

anyOf.description: Trusted provider precision in milliseconds. paidAt is the unchanged inclusive lower bound; missing legacy metadata means 1ms. Not accepted from buyer/OPS request bodies.

paidAtPrecisionMs.description: Null before a paid timestamp exists; otherwise the trusted precision of paidAt.
Trusted provider precision in milliseconds. paidAt is the unchanged inclusive lower bound; missing legacy metadata means 1ms. Not accepted from buyer/OPS request bodies.

PaymentRequest.description: Zero payable uses built-in INTERNAL/ZERO without external SDK or payer proof. Positive payable cannot use INTERNAL/ZERO; use an actual available configured route.

minor.description: Exact nonnegative signed-long minor amount (scale 2: TWD 69900 = NT$699.00), at most 9223372036854775807. All new HTTP responses use decimal integer strings.

title.description: Optional display name (1..64 chars), frozen with the SKU version; null = none, clients fall back to kind.

offlineReadiness.description: P3: offline bank-transfer purchasability; null when the deployment has no offline transfer. readiness stays online-only.

oneOf.description: Exact nonnegative signed-long minor amount, at most 9223372036854775807. All new HTTP responses use decimal integer strings. No TWD quantum change in Task4.

minor.description: Prefer decimal string. Fractional/float tokens, overflow, leading zeros and unsafe numeric integers rejected.

actualPaidAt.description: Actual bank credit time, whole seconds, not after now.

historical.description: Explicit manual back-entry before instructions were prepared.

OfflineConfirmRequest.description: Sales orders require an eligible collectorNo and a real collectionReference, no bankReference/claimNo. Bank orders require bankReference. Method is taken from the frozen order, never from this request.

unmatchedDispositions.description: Every MALL_UNMATCHED payment number on the order mapped to its disposition note.

OfflineProfileCommand.description: BANK_TRANSFER requires bankCode, bankAccount and accountName. SALES_COLLECTION requires contactInstructions and null bank fields. Missing collectionMethod retains legacy BANK_TRANSFER.

instructions.description: Empty when nothing is payable. Otherwise bank fields plus transferRemark (P3): order number, letters and digits only, to write on the transfer.

platformMerchantNo.description: Immutable receiving platform merchant frozen into this order; operators never enter this identifier manually.

bankReference.description: Buyer-declared transfer note / reference; a matching hint for operators, not proof of receipt

evidenceKeys.description: BUYER_RECEIPT asset keys; operators read them through /ops/biz-mall/offline/orders/{orderNo}/evidence/url

receivedAmount.description: P3: amount the platform recorded at review; only CONFIRMED/MISMATCHED.

status.description: ACCEPTED is recoverable; it is not money. Read the order's payment/fulfillment status for facts.

MallOrderDetailView_Line.description: P3: order line frozen from the quote SKU snapshot at order time.

CashRefundRequest.description: Refund the full remaining balance of this verified original payment. Amount, currency and original payment identity are frozen by the server.

paidOutAt.description: Whole-second actual outgoing transfer time, no later than now.

CashRefundPayout.description: Record an actual bank transfer; does not execute one. Requires stored private REFUND_PROOF. Replay the same actionNo with the exact original command; correct explicit rejection using a new actionNo.

CashRefundView.description: Buyer-safe progress only; excludes platform proof, payee identifiers and bank references. REFUNDED requires a verified complete refund fact. HTTP success alone is not refund completion.
